name: @absolutejs/commerce-square
description: Square Terminal adapter for @absolutejs/commerce — take a card at the counter on the shop's own hardware
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/manifest.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --target bun --external @absolutejs/commerce --external '@absolutejs/commerce/*' --external @absolutejs/manifest --external @sinclair/typebox && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run verify-package && bun run build
